LanguageData.APB.OpenFilterTip: Open the policy builder to build rules that toggle apparel in this policy by armor, insulation, coverage and other stats.
LanguageData.APB.Title: Apparel policy builder
LanguageData.APB.NoRules: No rules yet.\nPick an attribute on the left to add one.
LanguageData.APB.NoRulesExpression: Or create an expression to hold complex rules.
LanguageData.APB.NoRulesAdvancedHint: Enable advanced expressions in the mod settings to create more complex statements.
LanguageData.APB.FacetScopeTip: Applies to the whole policy; it can't be limited to a single layer.
LanguageData.APB.NewExpressionTip: Add an expression rule: an "any of / all of" combination of conditions, so you can say things like "move speed > 0 unless armor > 2". A piece is disallowed when the expression is false for it.
LanguageData.APB.ExprScopeTip: Which apparel this whole expression is evaluated against.
LanguageData.APB.PickForExpression: Pick an attribute to add as a condition.
LanguageData.APB.CopyTip: Copy this ruleset to the clipboard so it can be pasted into another apparel policy.
LanguageData.APB.PasteTip: Replace this policy's ruleset with the copied one. Applies only after you press Apply or Save.
LanguageData.APB.DocumentsTip: Save the current ruleset as a named document, or load and manage saved documents. Documents are shared across all your colonies.
LanguageData.APB.SaveDocTip: Save the current ruleset as a document under this name.
LanguageData.APB.NoDocuments: No saved documents yet.\nName the current ruleset above and press Save.
LanguageData.APB.OverwriteDocConfirm: A document named '{0}' already exists. Replace it?
LanguageData.APB.DiscardConfirm: Discard the current rules and replace them with the pasted ruleset?
LanguageData.APB.DiscardLoadConfirm: Discard the current rules and load '{0}'?
LanguageData.APB.SkippedRules: Skipped {0} rule(s) that reference content not in this modlist.
LanguageData.APB.Settings.AdvancedExpressionsDesc: Show the expression builder in the policy window, letting you combine conditions with any of / all of / not. Existing expressions keep applying when this is off.
LanguageData.APB.Settings.UtilityNote: Choose which apparel layers count as "utility". Utility layers are skipped by "Global except utility" rules and targeted by "Utility only" rules. Checked means utility; a '*' marks a layer you have changed from its default.
LanguageData.APB.Settings.ResetConfirm: Reset all utility-layer changes back to their defaults?
LanguageData.APB.EvalAsTip: How to read armor and insulation for stuffable apparel. "Multiplier" uses the material-effect multiplier so any piece that can take armor/insulation counts. Pick a material to instead use the actual value that material would give (only affects apparel that can be made from it).
LanguageData.APB.ApplyTip: Recompute the policy from scratch: allow all apparel, then remove every piece disqualified by a rule. Overwrites the policy's current toggles, and saves these rules.
LanguageData.APB.SaveTip: Save these rules without changing the policy's current apparel toggles.
